d: Jet black hair is styled with thick, rounded bangs and two low pigtails, framing a youthful, adolescent face. Large, bright azure eyes have a cheerful, wide-eyed expression. The slender build is dressed in a red, white, and black academic blazer with gold buttons over a dark tie, paired with a short, black pleated skirt, black socks, and red ankle boots. Signature details include a black tablet held under one arm and a small, thin headset microphone resting on the cheek.
